fields.why: Cessation indicators are reported and described as varying across age (4), race/ethnicity (5-6), education (7), income (3), insurance (5) and sexual orientation (3) groups.
Sex, urbanization (collapsed to urban/rural) and disability have 2 levels; region is geography, not an SPD.

Wald F tests compare menthol vs nonmenthol overall and within White, Black and Hispanic adults; no test is made across SPD groups. Mechanical flag is a false alarm: race is a stratum of a 2-group non-SPD contrast, not a margin of the test.
